declare_job.description: Declare a new job with label, machine id, origin, and copies

declare_layer.description: Declare a layer with label, color, kind, mode, speed, and power settings

comment.description: Add a comment line to the transcript

inline.description: Emit a raw Ruida Script command into the transcript

delay.description: Insert a fixed delay in seconds

wait.description: Wait for a machine status with a timeout in seconds

power_range.description: Set the min/max power ramp range for the layer (accel/decel)

cut_speed.description: Set the cut speed in mm/s for the current layer (comment-only; expansion not yet wired into rpascript)

move_speed.description: Set the move speed in mm/s for the current layer (comment-only; expansion not yet wired into rpascript)

frequency.description: Set the laser pulse frequency for the current layer (comment-only; expansion not yet wired into rpascript)

pwm.description: Set the laser pulse width in microseconds (max 1000us/1mS; comment-only - requires unverified SET_SETTING)

select_laser.description: Select the laser head (1-based); only head 1 is wired - emits LASER_DEVICE_1

move_xy_to.description: Move without cutting to an absolute (x, y) position

move_x_to.description: Move without cutting to an absolute x position

move_y_to.description: Move without cutting to an absolute y position

cut_xy_to.description: Cut to an absolute (x, y) position

cut_x_to.description: Cut to an absolute x position

cut_y_to.description: Cut to an absolute y position
